title: Scientists Catch a Rare Glimpse of a Fish With a See-Through Head - Nautilus
author: David Nield
text: Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisementZoologyScientists Catch a Rare Glimpse of a Fish With a See-Through HeadA barreleye’s peepers watch from inside its headDNBy David Nield9:00 AM CST on November 12, 2026Add Nautilus to GoogleThe barreleye fish—also known as the spookfish—is one of the strangest-looking critters in the ocean. The front of its head is semi-transparent, giving observers a clear look into its internal anatomy.It's not a fish that gets observed very often, though, which is why scientists are so excited about newly captured footage from the depths of the Monterey Canyon in the Pacific Ocean. Around 20 minutes of 4K video was recorded by a remotely operated vehicle (ROV) nearly 2,000 feet below the surface off the coast of California.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
